opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering outstanding quality teaching; institutions may apply once per round; individual scholars/students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Supports specialist arts institutions to provide training opportunities for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours, funding arts training for up to three years starting 1 Sept 2025.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: £5,000‑£10,000 per year per student; up to £475,000 total award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities offering undergraduate/postgraduate degrees; institutions may apply once per round; individual students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries of £5k‑£10k per year to outstanding undergraduate or postgraduate students in fine and performing arts, with awards possible in 2025‑2027.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 in year one; up to £28,000 in years two and three

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers without a permanent academic post, holding a doctorate, who have submitted their thesis for viva by the deadline; must be UK‑resident and hold a UK degree or UK academic post.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work; fellowship lasts 3 years with salary contribution up to £56k/yr (year 1) and £28k/yr (years 2‑3) plus up to £6k research expenses per year.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired UK‑based researchers who have held a UK university or eligible research institute post, resident in the UK for ≥26 weeks, and are research‑active.
opportunities.summary: Provides short‑term fellowships (3‑24 months) for retired scholars to complete or integrate research outputs; awards range £3k‑£24k.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities) may apply; scholarships are for doctoral students (including under‑represented groups) and limited post‑doctoral opportunities.
opportunities.summary: Centenary Doctoral Scholarships fund up to 30 doctoral scholarships (plus master‑plus‑PhD routes) and related programme costs; each award runs 9 years and supports 18 four‑year PhD scholarships plus additional activities.
discipline_tags: All disciplines within Trust remit (excluding clinical/medical)

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (with research degree‑awarding powers) may apply as principal applicant; collaborative centres encouraged; international partners may join.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of large‑scale, interdisciplinary research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship; funding up to £10 million over up to ten years.
discipline_tags: All disciplines within Trust remit (excluding clinical/medical)

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £6,000 per year for research expenses; salary costs covered

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established, distinguished researchers in humanities/social sciences employed at a UK university; must not already hold a Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ to three‑year fellowships supporting salary costs and up to £6k per year research expenses for senior researchers to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers at UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers; must be resident in the UK and have a permanent UK scholarly position.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £70,000 for experienced researchers to complete a piece of research; tenable 3‑24 months, with start dates between 1 June 2027 and 1 May 2028.
discipline_tags: All disciplines within Trust remit (excluding clinical/medical)

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK academic appointment (lecturer level or equivalent) who have not yet led a research team; institutions limited to one bid.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career researchers to build and lead a modest research team; award up to £1 million for 4‑5 years.
discipline_tags: All disciplines within Trust remit (excluding clinical/medical)

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (or eligible UK research institutes on a trial basis); principal investigators must be employed at the institution; projects must be fundamental research.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £500,000 for innovative research projects of up to five years; detailed applications follow successful outline stage.
discipline_tags: All disciplines within Trust remit (excluding clinical/medical)

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff (or specialist arts institutions) who will host an eminent overseas professor; host institution must have research degree‑awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funds visits of eminent senior professors from overseas to UK institutions for 3‑12 months, with awards between £10k and £150k.
discipline_tags: All disciplines within Trust remit (excluding clinical/medical)
